tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa ngor rdzong rdo rje gdan pa'i gsung rabs rin po che'i bang mdzod sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig bzhugs so// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po yab sras bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i zhal snga nas zhabs kyi pad+mo la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /dus thams cad du thugs rje brtse ba chen pos 'bral med du skyong zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sgron bskal bskal pa bzang po 'di la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong byon pa'i bzhi pa/ bdag cag gi ston pa thub dbang shākya seng ge'i bstan pa 'di la/ lam mchog gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa nub phyogs o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling / byang shaṃ bha la/ 'phags yul dbus 'gyur 'chang la sogs par dar zhing rgyas pa las/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ bstan pa dar bar gsungs pa'i pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gdul bya'i don du bsam bzhin du sprul pa'i skyes mchog chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi sku drin las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin chen dbu brnyes/ srol gtod/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ slar yang lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug la sogs pa dang / sprul pa'i skyes mchog lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po la sogs pas stod smad nas dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i skabs/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po ste dge bsnyen gyi rnam par sprul pa/ rgyal ba 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dbus gtsang du spyan drangs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dri ma med pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/

phebs lam du skal ldan mang po rjes su gzung zhing / gdul bya bgrang las 'das pa smin grol la bkod/ dpal zhwa lu gser khang gi chos grwa chen po'i gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa la rab tu gnas pa mdzad cing yum chen sher phyin gyi spyan la me tog chags pas/ phar phyin gyi bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel 'grig bstan pa dar rgyas yong ba dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku rang byung du 'byon par lung bstan pa sogs dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i gnas gzhi thams cad byin gyis rlabs/ dpal sna thang gi chos grwa chen po la sogs pa lung bstan/ khyad par grom stod dpal ldan sa skya'i brag dkar po'i logs la dhīḥbadun dang hūm̐ gcig gzigs pas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa gcig 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i/ dang po bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba la sogs pa mkhas grub mang po bsten/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgya cher btsugs pas/ dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes bstan pa rgya mtsho lta bur bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ kyai rdo rje bde mchog dmar po skor gsum mgon po che chung sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa re re tsam ma gtogs gtso bor gdung rgyud rim par chig brgyud kyi tshul du byon pa thams cad bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bka' babs pa bum pa gang 'jo'i tshul du bskal bzang dang po'i sangs rgyas rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po la gnang yang / bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa rgyal ba rab gsal gyi rnam sprul bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa chen po nas rim par brgyud/ mdo bstan bcos gangs can du 'gyur ba'i thub bstan yongs rdzogs lta bu dang / bye brag tu rgyud sde'i snying po khrid chen bzhi la sogs pa dang / rgyal bas lung bstan rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po yab sras nas/

rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang rgyud man ngag rgya mtsho lta bu/ rgyal ba 'brom ston pa'i rnam sprul rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje la bka' babs pa rnams kyang / rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po la gnang / de ltar bka' babs gnyis ldan gdams pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis la gsan pa'i zab chos phal cher/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam sprul/ tshar chen rdo rje chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la chos kyi bdag por dgongs nas gnang bas/ lugs srol 'di la thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan pa'i bdag po kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags te/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las/ sa dbus gtsang khams gsum sman ljongs na/ /nged kun spangs chos rje'i bu brgyud la/ /chos zab mo gdam pa'i snyan grags yod/ /de thob 'dod kyi rtsab rtsob mang na yang / /thob nges pa'i skal ldan re re tsam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas gsung ngag lam 'bras ni spyir rgyud 'chad thabs phyi nang gzhan gsum gyis 'chad pa/ mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi'i 'chad pa/ tshogs bshad dang slob bshad kyi 'chad pa sogs las 'dir tshogs slob kyis 'chad pa las/ rje 'brog mi'i gsung las/ rna ba drug pa chos kyi dben/ /rna bzhi pa la chos mi bshad/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lam 'bras yin na slob bshad yin pas khyab/ sa chen nas gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la rim gyis 'phel ste rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i dus su/ tshogs pa byings la thun mong gi gdams pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad rnams 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan kho na la gnang / des bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po la gnang ba dang / rje btsun yab dang mkhan chen dkon mchog bzang po las kyang / thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa mang po gsan pas sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po'i rnam sprul/

bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa mnga' bas/ thun mong pa la tshogs bshad dang thun mong ma yin pa la slob bshad ces 'chad pa la/ kun la ma grags pas/ ngor pa'i zhal slob phal cher kyai rdor la slob bshad med gsung / mkhas mchog gung ru sher bzang dang / zhwa lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang / ngor pa la slob bshad yod par gsung / de la 'dir gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad 'chad thabs la/ gang 'chad pa'i slob dpon ni/ smin byed rgyu dus kyi dbang thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ lam dus kyi dbang thob nas/ lam dus rab thun bzhi'am/ gsum/ tha mas kyang thun gnyis ma chag pas dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa gzhi'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mthar phyin pa rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ gang la 'chad pa'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing / bla ma dang chos la gus pa/ snying nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa grangs nyer lnga yan chad la gnas dben par/ dus bzang po gza' skar sbyor byed tshes grangs dge ba la/ gnas khang byi dor dkon mchog gi rten mchod gtor slob dpon gyi khri rgyan bkod sogs bkod pas mdzes pa mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa nyer sdogs legs par grub nas/ 'jam mgon mkhyen rtses mdzad pa'i snang gsum 'khrid yig bstan pa rgyas byed las byung ba ltar dbu btsugs te/ tshig don thams cad de kha sor bzhag de'i dpang por 'khrid yig jo lcags ma dang / sbas don gsal ba'i dgongs don ma 'khrul ba byas nas/ thog mar slob dpon khri la 'khod de/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ tad+ya thā/…'di mthar/ sha me/…zhi ba/ sha ma wa ti …zhi ba dang ldan pa/ sha mi ta/…dgra bo zhi ba/ sha truṃ a ku re/…sdig pa 'joms pa/ maṃ ku re/…'chi ba 'joms pa/ ma ra dzi ta/…bdud las rgyal ba/

kar+ṣa te/…khug ke ū re/…lcags sgro/ tā+e dz+wa wa ti/…gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ o lo ya ti/…spyan ras gzigs/ bi ṣa thā/…thogs med/ nirma le/…dri ma med pa/ mā la pa na ye/…dri ma spangs pa/ khu khu te…gti mug gcad pa/ kha ne/…mkha' 'gro/ gra sa ne gra se/…sdig pa zad zad chung / rak+ṣa/ aṃ mu khī/…gtso bo/ sa ra mu khī/…mchog gis gtso bo/ a mu khī/…kun gyi gtso bo/ sha mi tā ni/…zhi ba/ sarba gra hā ni/…gza' thams cad/ ban+dha tā ni/…gdong la sbu/ ni tri hī ti/…gnod pa/ sarba pa ra wā di/…gzhan gyi dug thams cad/ rab tu/ na ni muk+ta/…rnam par grol ba/ mā ra pra sha…bdud las/ rnyog bral/ s+d+yā si ta bud+dha mu trā/…sangs rgyas kyi phyag rgyas/ u nud gha ṭi na/…gnod pa mi tshugs pa/ sarba …bdud thams cad kyis mā rai pu tsa …legs par spyod pa'i/ ri ta pa ri …mchog yongs su dag pa/ shud+dha ni …bral ba bsam pa/ gats+tshan+tu/ sarba …thams cad/ mā ra …bdud/ karma …las ṇi/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i 'di dag ni bdud tshar gcad pa'i tshig nyon mongs pa bsal ba'i tshig ste/ de dag chos smra ba des legs par kha ston du byas la/ chos kyi khri la 'dug ste/ byang chub kyi rnam pa mngon par sgrub pa'i byams pas/ 'khor thams cad khyab par byas la/ bdag la sman par 'du shes bskyed de/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes dang / chos nyan pa la nad pa'i 'du shes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes dang / chos kyi tshul yun du gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed la sngags kyi tshig 'di dag sngon du byas te/ chos kyi gtam byed na/ de'i khor yug dpag tshad brgyad tshun chad du bdud dang bdud kyi rigs kyi lha rnams kyi mig bsgyur ba'i las kyi phyir 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang dag 'ong ba de dag kyang bar chad byed par mi nus so zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyi byams snying rje sogs kyis kun nas blangs pa'i ngag tu sngags 'di nyid/

gsum/ bdun/ nyer gcig sogs ji ltar rigs pa shib bur kha ton du bya'o/ /slob ma rnams tshogs nas ngor lugs snang gsum phar phyin gyi lam du bzhed pas/ mchod gtor yig brgya/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i bsrung 'khor rnams mi mdzad/ 'phags pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod med sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i shes rab snying po'i mdo dal drel pa dang bstun pa'i tshar ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes su zlog pa dang bcas mdo sgrub yon tan rgya mtsho ma tshar gsum/ lam 'bras phyag mchod chen mo mchod pa la rol chen sogs dang bcas/ rgyas par sgrub pa dang…mdzad srol 'dug lags/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o zhes ngor pa rnams gsung gdang ring ba mdzad/ tshar lugs pa rnams 'o zhes thung tsam mdzad pas 'go drangs te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes pa nas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thun gsum byas kyang rung / rgyun chad med par grub kyang shin tu legs pa yin gsungs/ zhes pa'i bar 'khrid yig dkyus bzhin las/ skyabs yul gyi skabs su chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu/ lha rdzas pañtsa li kha'i na zas klubs pa/ gla gdong ngam/ cha re ba/ gdong dar phra bun ne ba/ zhes kyang res 'ga' gsung / gnyis pa sems bskyed ni 'og nas rgyas par 'byung bas ma grub kyang chog byed par spro na gong du smos pa ltar zhes pa nas/ gsum pa nyung mtha' byas pa brjod ces pa'i bar tshar gcig song ba dang nub dang po la tshar gsum/ sang skyar chos kyi tshul du tshar re ste tshar bzhi mdzad/ bzhi bshad zhes phyag chen du gnang / do nub nas rang rang gi gnas mal rnams su byon/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug rlung rngam pa rang babs su ma gyur gyi bar du lhod grol la rang babs su mnyam par bzhag rnam rtog gcig thol gyis skyes na de'i dbang du mi gtong bar dmigs pa la 'jug de ltar dpon slob 'dus nas 'chad nyan byed pa'i thog mar zhes pa nas/

zhes pa man chad gong bzhin tshar gnyis bshad pa'i rjes su/ thun de las ldang bar 'dod na bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas btab/ mnyam bzhag tu de ltar du bsgom/ rjes thun mtshams thams cad du yang 'gro 'jog nyal 'dug spyod lam rnam bzhi ci byed kyang mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi dbang du ma song bar spyod lam dge bas dus 'da' bar mdzad nas/ de ring gi thugs dam de tsam la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig rgyas par spro na/ theg mchog dam chos rin chen bshad 'di las/…'phags pa thogs med kyis/ slob dpon gyis/ theg mchog dam chos rin chen bshad 'di las/ /zhes dang / slob ma rnams kyis/ theg mchog dam chos rin chen nyan 'di las zhes brjod/ zhes sogs rgyas par bya'o/ /sang slob ma rnams tshogs nas/ mdo sgrub yon tan rgya mtsho ma tshar gsum/ lam 'bras phyag mchod rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'tshams pa/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du nas/ byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs skyed pa gsal btab ste gsan par zhu zhes sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ mchod pa gsol btab sogs nyin re bzhin mi dgos pas/ chos nyan pa'i kun tu spyod pa gsal gdab pa zhes bya bar ston par byed zhes pa man sems bskyed kyi bar skyar chos tshar gcig bshad nas/ gnyis pa bar du dge ba so so'i dmigs pa sgom pa la zhes sogs nas rtsam ste dmigs pa nyin re la ji tsam 'os pa tshar gsum re ma chad pa sogs rigs 'gre zhing / de'i sang nas slob ma rnams 'tshogs nas/ mdo sgrub sogs sngar bzhin dang / 'o nam mkha' dang sogs sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ chos nyan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes su/ 'dir gang bshad pa dang nyan par bya ba'i chos ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam zhes pa nas/ lam gzhi bca' ba sngon du 'gro tshul dang / lam dngos nyams su blang ba la gnyis/

zhes sogs sa bcad ma nor bar byas/ rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'tshams pas sa bcad skabs gang yin de 'chad par byed cing / 'chad lugs tshig dal la go bde ba mdzad/ bstan pa rgyas byed du phyag bris hor gong mus pa khyad par snying rje sgom pa'i skabs na/ gnyis pa sems can la dmigs pa ni sbas don gsal bar/ bdag gi ma 'di rnams sems can nam gang zag gi bdag tu ma grub kyang / ma rig pa las bdag rang sems can du brtags te sdug bsngal bar gyur pa 'di snying re rje snyam du bsam pa la sogs pa sngar bzhin snying rje sgom mo/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mar shes pa/ drin dran pa gnyis dang 'dun pa sogs bzhi gong gi rigs 'gre sbyar te gsol btab kyi bar bya/ gsum pa dmigs med kyi snying rje ni/ sbas don gsal bar/ sems can 'di dag rang bzhin gyi bden par grub pa ma yin kyang / gang zag dang chos su bden par mngon par zhen pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sdug bsngal ba 'di dag snying re rje na/ zhes sogs sngar bzhin bsgom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas mar 'du shes pa nas/ gsol 'debs kyi bar gong bzhin rigs 'gre sbyar te bsgom/ gsum pa byang chub sems pa nas/ snang gsum rdzogs pa'i mtha'i/ ngas yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur ba nyid du thob par byed snyam du yang yang bsam par bya gsung ngo / /de ltar snang gsum rdzogs pa'i sang / sems skyed chen po thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin mdzad/ yang na/ rang lugs skabs su babs pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa bzhin/ de'i dgongs mo slob ma rjes 'dzin mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa sor gzhag do nub nas dpon slob tshang ma zhag bdun sku mtshams mdzad nas/ thun bzhi'i tshul gyi slob ma rnams kyis srod tho rangs gtso bor yig brgya dang / nyin mo'i thun gnyis la gtso bor maṇ+ḍal byas pa'i gsag sbyangs la 'bad/

slob dpon gyis bum pa la brten pa'i bsnyen pa thun bzhir rje btsun bka' 'gyur bas mdzad pa'i lung dang rnam bshad gtong lugs kyi nang nas 'byung ba ltar mdzad pa'i bum chu des dbang bskur ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa mdzad/ sku mtshams grol nas rgyu dbang bskur ba'i cho ga…nges par rdul mtshon kyi dkyil 'khor du/ sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa la tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi lhan thabs sbyar/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gtso bor rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i dbang chu chen mo/ de'i gsal byed brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa bzhin phyag len du snang lags/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i dbang chog chen mo sor gzhag dbang lha gdan gsum tshang ba spyan 'dren gyi gzhug gdan/ bskyed rim rnam bshad dang / bla ma rin po che bsod nams chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed dbang chog bzhin dang / dbang stegs rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang slob ma re re nas bskur ba de dus slob dpon dbu thog gi gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan rnams dbang stegs kyi steng dang g.yas g.yon du bkod/ dbang grol nas lam 'bras ma grol bar/ slob ma gtso bo de'i dbu thog dang g.yas g.yon du gdugs sogs bkod/ sngags sdom thob mtshams bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bzhed pa ltar/ bum dbang gi rjes su thob pa sogs/ rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa rnams dbang chu chen mo dang / brag phug pa kun rgyal gyi dbang chog dang / sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang chog sogs las byung ba ma nor bar sbyar nas/ dbang chog dbang bshad thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog chen mo bzhin dang / bsdu dgos byung na/ dbang chog chung ba bzhin mdzad na don dang mthun zhing mkhas pa rnams yid 'phrog pa 'byung /

rgyud gsum ma tshugs pa'i thog mar/ slob ma rnams 'tshogs 'phral bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo zhes he ru ka'i yig brgya ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes sogs bshags sdom/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ tshad med bzhi nas uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i srung 'khor/ skyed mchog bzlas pa ci grub/ bha ya na gsum/ dmod pa 'dor ba yan/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sogs/ yon tan rgya mtsho ma tshar gsum/ rnam dag dkyil 'khor bzhi yi 'dzin ma la sogs/ zab cing blo gros kyi sogs/ brgyud 'debs kun bzang ma kha skong dang bcas pa/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'i rjes su/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal/ de'i bar la bla mas kyai rdor gyi gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhin/ sngags lam tshugs nas/ ci snang thams cad lha'i rnam rol du shes dgos pas/ chos nyan pa'i kun spyod kyang / 'di ltar mdzad pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ chos nyan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang / sku lus kyi 'dug stangs drang por gnas pa dang / thugs kyi bsam pas/ gnas khang 'di nyid tha mal gyi snang ba 'di lta bu ma yin te/ dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i/ thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du tshud pa'i dbus su/ da lta chos ston pa'i slob dpon kyang / tha mal gyi snang ba 'di lta bu ma yin te/ seng ge chen po brgyad kyis stegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du bzhugs pa'i/ bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje bdag med ma dang snyoms par sbyor ba/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba dngos yin snyam pa dang /

khyed rang rnams kyang de lta bu'i lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ chos kyi sgra dbyangs grag stong skye ba med pa sgrogs pa/ srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i sgra lhang lhang yod snyam pa dang bcas pa'i ngang nas/ gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang nas g.yeng med kyi tshul du gsan par zhu/ 'dir gang bshad pa dang nyan par bya ba'i chos ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ zhes sogs nas/ snang ba gsum gyi lam gyi gzhi bcas te/ /nyams blang ma lus rgyud gsum dag gi shes/ /zhes pa'i sngar bzhin las/ snang ba gsum du bstan pa'i 'khrid song nas/ rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i khrid 'chad par byed pa la zhes sbyar/ gzhan gong 'og thams cad 'khrid yig bstan pa rgyas byed na gsal bar bzhugs pas smos ma dgos lags/ phyi dkyil gyi sems 'dzin grub mtshams su/ lam dbang bskur chog bdag chen rdo rje chang chen pos mdzad pa bzhin bskur ro/ /de nas bzung lam dus kyi dbang len pa thun bzhi ma chag pa byed/ rmi lam bar do'i nyams len kho na la 'bad pa gal che ba yin gsungs zhes pa yan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig bstan pa rgyas byed las byung ba bzhin/ de man gsung rtsom mdzad 'phro la lus pa'i kha skong bum dbang gi rmi lam man snying por dril ba/ rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos bka' stsal ba'i gsung rab kyi mdo gzung / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab bstan gyi bka' las/ mdzad 'phro la las pa ma yin gyi 'khrid kyi dmigs rim/ bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i sbas don gsal ba sor bzhag rmi lam bar do sogs/ mkhan chen klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i khrid yig las blang ste 'chad pa yin gsungs/ de ltar yongs su rdzogs nas/ lam bsdus te sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa man/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i zin bris bzhin mdzad/

de ltar na 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i byin rlabs sogs kyi zin bris gsung ji lta ba bzhin bris pa ni/ tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs la/ maṇ+ḍal/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhi sku/ /bla ma'i sku la nas/ bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid nas/ bdag la byin rlabs bstsal du gsol/ /gsum/ slob dpon don grub tu rgyas par gsal gdab/ phyi nang gsang ba'i tshe lha mo rnams bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu/ thugs kar thim par bsam/ de nyid rnams kyi sngags la rjes zlos bya'o/ /oṃ gu ru sogs kyi gsol gdab tshar gsum/ bla ma'i dbral bar oṃ dang / phyag g.yas kyi mthil du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung ba cha brgyad pa'i lte ba'i swa yig dkar po'i dbus nas/ 'od dkar po oṃ yig ge 'phreng ba dang bcas pa byon sogs dang / bla ma'i phyag slob ma'i dpral bar reg cing oṃ brjod/ de bzhin du/ mgrin/ thugs/ swa yig ge dbus dang bcas pa'i spro bsdu/ phyag mgrin snying du reg cing / āḥdang hūm̐ brjod gnas gsum char dang swa yig gi dbus nas 'bru gsum dus gcig la byung / gnas gsum nas zhugs/ lus thams cad khengs/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum 'khod par bsam la/ phyag gnas gsum du reg cing 'bru gsum brjod/ re re la dag bya/ thob bya/ dbang gi ngo sprod/ deng nas sogs 'dra/ bla ma rin 'byung gi byin rlabs la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma theng gsum/ gang drin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po/ sh+lau ka gnyis dang bcas pas gsol ba btab/ bla ma rin 'byung du bskyed/ mchod pa la rjes zlos/ dpal ldan bla ma yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sogs kyi gsol gdab tshar gsum/ bla ma'i phyag g.yas pa las dgos 'dod char bzhin du babs/ rang gi gnas khang lung pa sogs khengs/

bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par byas/ bla ma'i sku las 'od ser po 'phros/ slob ma'i lus khyab pa'i rkyen gyis gdan lnga rtsegs kyi steng du slob ma rin 'byung du bskyed/ phyag las dgos 'dod babs rigs drug bar dor bcas pa tshims par byas/ thams cad kyang rin 'byung du bsgyur/ de rnams rang sems su thag bcad/ mthar snang srid rin 'byung du gsal ba dang bla ma 'od du zhu/ slob ma la thim par bsam zhing 'dzin med du 'jog tu gzhug bla mas dril bu gsil zhing / a āḥnas aṃ a'i bar tshar gsum/ bla ma dam pa yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan gyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la byin gyis brlabs du gsol sogs gdab cing lta ba la bzhag deng nas sogs 'dra/ 'di gnyis chag med grub na legs/ rje bla ma nyid ni chag med du mdzad kyin 'dug gsung ngo / /brda don gsal ba'i byin rlabs la slob dpon gyi bya ba lam dus/ gtor bsngo tsam bya'i/ rdo la bskyed chog sogs ni gang yang mi mdzad/ maṇ+ḍal/ gang drin sh+lau ka gcig dang / kun mkhyen sh+lau ka gnyis kyi gsol ba btab/ dngos gzhi la/ dang po gleng gzhi'i lo rgyus bshad pa/ bar tu byin gyis rlabs pa/ mthar brda don sde bzhi ngo sprod/ dang po ni/ yi ge bzhin bshad/ gnyis pa bla ma he ru kar gsal ba dang / mdun gyi nam mkha' la rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ rdo rje slob ma'i lag tu gtad cing mgo bor bzhag ste/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po nas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan la ji ltar gdam pa'i don thams cad rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces slob ma re re bzhin brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rdo rje phyag tu gzung ste/ gsung ngag rin po che lam thams cad 'dis mtshon nus pa yin te/ rdo dkar zhing dwangs la yid du 'ong bas/ sems kun gzhi cir yang bsgyur du tub ba mtshon/

gru bzhi ni 'khor 'das thams cad la phyogs ris med du khyab pa/ de'i steng gi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyis pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyis ma gos pa ltar/ kun gzhi de'i ngo bo nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gi ma gos pa mtshon/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma stong pa yod pas kun gzhi de'i ngo bo byed pa/ rgyu 'bras thams cad stong par mtshon pa ste/ mdor na shes rab lta bas thag gcad pa kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi lam thams cad mtshon/ lus thabs rgyud kyi lam dbang bzhi'i lam gyis bum dbang gi lam ni lte ba'i yi ge gnyis kyis mtshon/ gtso bo yab yum gyis mtshon pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ste/ dang po chos nyid gdan du byas/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsang dbang gi lam ni/ nub byang gi ya la klad skor byin pa'i yaṃ ni rlung gi sa bon te rlung gi sbyor ba bdun mtshon la/ gnyis pa rlung la spar zin bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ nub kyi ra la thig les brgyan pas raṃ ni me'i sa bon te/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad bstan te/ gtum mo'i me drod rab tu skye/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa'i lam ni/ shar lho'i ba la thig les brgyan pa'i baṃ ni chu yi sa bon te/ byang chub kyi sems zhu bde mi rtog pa gsum lam du byed pa ste/ byang sems chu rgyun dbu mar zhugs/ /zhes pas bstan/ byang shar gyi la la thig le byin pa'i laṃ ni sa'i sa bon te/ des mtshon pa'i 'byung ba bzhi'i rba rlabs rengs pa bzhi pa'i lam ste/ sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du bsdu/ /zhes pas bstan/ ye shes lnga ni mngon gyur nas/ /'chi ba med pa'i gnas thob bo/ /zhes pas lam de bsgom pa'i 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes lnga thob pa ste/ mdor na gsung ngag rin po che'i don thams cad 'dis mtshon nus pa yin gsungs/ deng nas sogs 'gre/ brda chig brgyud kyi byin gyis rlabs la/ maṇ+ḍal/ gang drin sh+lau ka gcig gi gsol gdab/…dang /

kun mkhyen ye shes sh+lau ka dpon slob thun mong uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i bsrung 'khor sgom nas sngags bdun tsam bzlas/ de nas yol ba stang ba'i nang du slob ma re re bzhin bos nas dbang bzhi'i brda' bslab/ mthar thams cad thun mong du dam la bzhag pa bzhi'i dam la gzhag uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i bsdus nas maṇ+ḍal/ deng sogs 'dra ste/ sngon 'gro slob dpon la gsol ba btab pa/ dngos gzhi brda bslab pa/ rjes dam pa bzhag cing gsang bar gdam pa gsum gyis bsdus so/ /mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang la/ maṇ+ḍal/ gang drin/ sangs rgyas kun/ kun mkhyen ye shes sh+lau ka gnyis kyi gsol gdab/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rgyun bshags/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pas bdag la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa bstsal du gsol gsum/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun gyi tshom bu lhar gsal ba'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i 'od kyis slob ma sbyangs pa las lhar bskyed/ mig tu ti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyis skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas pas ye shes pa phab pa sku/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas sngags 'phreng byung / snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim zhing 'khod par bsam la/ yi ge bdun pa dang / sha sa na tshar gsum/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la sogs bya ba gsung / slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rang nag po chen po ches gsal bar byas pa sems gtad de/ 'di ltar gang du yang ma grub bzhin du thabs khyad par can de dag la brten nas rang nyid gur gyi mgon po snang stong zung 'jug gdangs 'gag med du shar ba 'dis mtshon/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems sgyu ma/ de rten 'brel/ de brjod bral du ngo sprad la bzo med du skyong du 'jug pa thugs/ bla ma'i phyag 'phreng ske la skon/

gtor ma mgo bor bzhag gsung ngag brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi bla ma'i mtshan gyi mthar bka' bsgo dkyus bzhin la/ khyad par rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams gsung ngag rin po che nyams su len pa dang gzhan la ston pa sogs thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bya ba gang byed kyang / phyi rol bdud/ ting nge 'dzin sems/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ ces sogs kyi bka' bsgo/ gtor ma'i lha spyi bo nas bstims/ deng nas sogs 'dra/ dus gcig la slob ma gsum las mang ba mi mdzad do/ /rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs bdag chen rin po che'i yi ge ji lta ba bzhin mdzad do/ /lam bsdus de sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'i byin rlabs la/ maṇ+ḍal/ lam bsdu ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rabs thams cad kyi snying po gsang sngags/ de 'ang bla med/ de 'ang kyai rdo rje/ de'i brjod bya'i don ma lus par gsung ngag rin po cher 'dus shing / de'i brjod don mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par lam dus thun gcig tu 'dus pas na lam gyi snying po 'di kho na yin/ 'dus tshul yang snang ba gsum gyi nyams len thams cad ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed du 'dus/ rgyud gsum las kun gzhi rgyu'i rgyud kyi nyams len thams cad ye shes tshogs gsag dang / rgyu rdor 'dzin zhu ba'i gong bu la mnyam par bzhag par 'dus/ lus thabs rgyud kyi bum dbang gi lam phyi nang gi bskyed rim dang / gsang dbang gi lam rlung gtum mor dngos su tshang / shes rab ye shes kyi lam 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba dang 'bras bu rdor 'dzin du bzhengs pa'i rgyu'i snyoms 'jug la tshang / der ma zad lam gyi dbang bzhi rang la lam de dag rgyas par tshang ba'i phyir/ des na la la dag khyed kyi lam 'bras tshang ba'i nyams len ci thub/ lam dus ma chag tsam a yong ltos zer ba mang po yong gi gda' ste/

gnad ma go bar gda' gsung / de la chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis/ lam 'bras 'khrid kyi snying po ni/ /sogs gsungs pa'i don la ngor pa byings la dang po nas rim bzhin brgyud pa'i 'phros ye med/ phyis su rtog bzos 'bru bsnon byas pa'i lab lob mang po byed pa la snying po ci yang med/ rang lugs/ ring brgyud pa dang / nye brgyud gnyis las 'ongs pa'i nyams su blang bya'i gtso bor mngon rtogs dang / lam dus kyi dbang chog gnyis yin la/ de la gsum byung ba ni/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ste/ mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi pa/ 'bring drug pa/ bsdus pa ni/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems kyi rjes su gzhan med par tshad med bzhi sgom nas ye shes tshogs bsags byas/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du lha so so'i gdan dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ rang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du gsal ba'i zhes pa'i bar lam gyis sgom pas chog gi re re nas gsal 'debs mi dgos/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs man dkyus bzhin la/ bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs don dran bzhin pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥlan gsum brjod pas rung gsungs/ dbang rgyas 'bring sdus gsum ni dkyus ltar/ 'bring po'i tshe/ rig pa'i dbang lnga rdo rje brtul zhugs dang drug dam tshig gsum dang bcas pa thob byung snyam pa'i nges shes/ gsang dbang gi bdud rtsi lce thog tu myangs/ lus khengs pa dang / gsum pa'i tshe dri ba dri lan sngon du 'gro bas snyoms par zhugs/ dga' bzhi lugs zlog tu skyes byung snyam pa'i nges shes yid ches pa re bskyed dgos gsungs/ mtshon bya don gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes yod na 'das pa'i rtog pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes/ da ltar gyi rig pa skad cig ma la dbang bzhi tshang ba yin/

gsal ba'i cha/ bum dbang / stong pa'i gsang dbang / dbyer med pa gsum pa/ de'i ngo bo blo las 'das pa bzhi pa ste/ mdor na chu la sogs pas rab bkrus bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbang gi chu bo rab ye shes/ 'bring nges shes/ tha ma tshig la bzhag pa'i phyir/ ye shes brgyud la skyes na legs/ ma skyes kyang dbang de dang de thob/ dri ma de dang de dag thob bya de dang de mngon du byas pa yin snyam pa'i nges shes ma skyes na/ shar sbyangs tsam des don gyi chu bo nub 'gro bas nan tan cher bya gsungs/ gnyis pa lung sbyin pa ni nyams su blang ba'i rnal 'byor pa la gsang ba bcu'i rgyas gdab ste/ skal ldan la phan par gdams pa ste 'di la gsum/ dus khyad par can la mkha' 'gro mnga' mnyes par bya ba/ lung sbyin pa dngos/ rjes bka' rgyas btab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo cho ga ji lta bar sgrub tshar ba des 'thus/ gnyis pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /khyed kyi thugs rje'i sku drin gyis/ /bdag la byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /gsum/ bla ma zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid khyab bdag he ru ka phyag bcu drug par gsal ba'i steng gi cha la/ zung 'jug rdo rje chang yab yum/ mthu stobs dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras sogs gsung ngag brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi bla ma rnams mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de dag gi mtha' bskor du/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la sogs pa chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad dges bzhin du sprin phung ltar thebs se bzhugs pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ khyed rang la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i lung sbyin byung snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bskrun/ /zhes pa nas/ bde chen chos sku nam mkha' mthong /

/bdag rgyud byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ /tshar gcig rdo rje 'chang nas/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan rim bzhin brjod de/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bka' drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i zhal snga nas kyi bdag la gnang ba'i bar dang / gzhan yang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ yab 'jam dbyangs chen po la gsan pa dang / 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po la gsan pa sogs brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi bla ma rnams kyi gsung ngag rin po che nyams su bzhes pa la 'jig rten chos kyi phyi rol bdud kyi bdud stobs 'phel ba'i gtad las sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad las rgyal ba de bzhin du/ 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams gsung ngag rin po che nyams su len pa la 'jig rten chos dang gtad las sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig ces tshar gcig brjod cing me tog gtor/ des bar chad mi 'byung ba'i lung thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad khyed rang rnams kyis bshad sgrub gang byed kyang bar chad mi 'byung bar nges pa yin no gsungs/ yang de dag gi sgrub pa'i lung sbyin byung snyam pa/ dkyil 'khor lnga nas/ bdag rgyud byin gyis bslab tu gsol tshar gcig rdo rje 'chang nas/ rnams kyi gsung ngag rin po che nyams su bzhes pa'i tshe/ zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can thugs brgyud la 'khrungs pa bzhin du sogs/ des sgrub pa'i lung thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad sngar dang mi 'dra ba bar zung 'jug gi rtogs pa khyad par du 'phags pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro gsungs so/ /yang de dag gis mgrin gcig tu bshad pa'i lung sbyin byung snyam pas/ dkyil 'khor lnga nas/ brlab tu gsol tshar gcig rdo rje 'chang nas/ de dag gi sgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i rjes su sems can gyi don bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'grub pa de bzhin du/

deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sgrub pa mthar phyin nas/ gzhan don bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'grub par gyur cig ces tshar gcig dang me tog 'thor/ de ltar byas pa'i bshad pa'i lung thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad gzhan la 'chad pa'i tshe/ rang gzhan la bgegs dang bar chad mi 'byung / gzhan rgyud smin par nus pa sogs gzhan don mtshan nyid 'grub pa yin no/ /des na bar chad med pa/ sgrub pa/ bshad pa'i lung rnams sbyin pa la brten nas/ khyed rang rnams nyams su len pa dang / gzhan la ston pa sogs gang byed kyang rang dbang thob te/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs ye mi 'byung zhing / mthun rkyen 'bad med du 'byung bar bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pas zhal gyis bzhes pa yin pas/ de dag gi zhal bzhes bskul ba'i tshul/ chos 'chad pa sogs kyi tshe gsol ba 'debs par byed pa yin/ gsum pa ni/ dam du sba zhing dam du spel/ /zhes gsungs pas byung rgyal du mi 'chad par/ snod rtags te rim bzhin ston dgos pas/ snod ma rtags par dbang mi bskur/ dbang ma bskur bar 'khrid mi bya/ 'khrid ma byas par gdam ngag mi bya ste gzhung bshad mi ston/ gdam ngag ma sbyin par bka' rgya mi 'debs pa yin gsungs nas/ gsang bcu'i rnam bzhag yi ge bzhin no/ /sa ma ya'i lung dang rnam bshad gtong lugs rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba'i gsung ji lta ba bris pa ni/ rgyab brten lung dang / rnam bshad gtong tshul ni/ snang gsum dus bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar gyi lung / chos byung tshul khog phugs kyi bshad pa/ snang gsum rdzogs ma thag sems bskyed phog de rjes sdom pa nyi shu pa'i rtsa 'grel gyi lung bshad/ de 'phral slob ma rjes 'dzin/ de rjes slob mas gsag sbyangs/ bla mas bsnyen pa kha gso dang bum sgrub/ bsnyen pa kha gso ni lam dus bzlas pa dang bcas par thun bzhir byas pa'i thun gyi mthar bum pa sgrub pa yin te/ mdun du bum pa dung chos gzungs thag nang rdzas bcas pa bshams/

mtshams la zhugs 'phral gyis thun dang po'i lam dus bzlas pa grub 'phral dbang bskur dus kyi rnam rgyal bum sgrub sor bzhag las/ las bum mi dgos…gzungs thag gzung nas bum nang gi lha'i sku las bdud rtsi babs par bsam la bzlas pa ci 'grub dang mchod bstod byas/ lha mi zhu/ de man gyi thun thams cad la bum par lha gsal btab pa tsam las/ bskyed chog mi dgos bzlas pa bya/ mtshams grol khar bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod byas/ dung chos kyi mchod yon phul nas lha zhu/ bum chu de rgyu dbang gi mi bskyod pa chu dbang gi bum chu mdzad pa lags/ rgyu dbang grub nas lam tshugs/ slob ma 'tshogs phral/ yig brgya ci rigs kyi mthar bdag ni mi shes zhes pa'i bshags sdom/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ tshad med bzhi nas uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i bsrung 'khor bskyed pa bzlas pa bha ya na'i dmod pa 'dor ba yan/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'i rjes su/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal/ de'i bar la bla mas mchod gtor bsngo/ de nas glegs bam gang 'gro/ de nas bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bshad pa thugs nas mdzad na gang 'gro/ thugs nas mi mdzad na lung gcig byas nas/ rtsa ltung rnam bshad gang 'gro btang nas/ 'khor dpag med kyi 'khrid dmigs rim btang / phyi dkyil gyi sems 'dzin grub nas lam dbang bskur/ rtsa ltung bshad pa rdzogs nas bskyed rim rnam bshad/ de dang mnyam pa tsam du lus dkyil sems 'dzin/ bum dbang rdzogs nas bdag med ma'i dbang dang byin rlabs bya/ de nas bsrung 'khor rnams ston pa dang / gsang dbang gi dmigs pa rim par phog bskyed rim bshad pa grub nas/ nang dkyil bshad pa dang / sher dbang dang bzhi pa'i bar la/ lam zab kyi byin rlabs dang / de'i sgom tshul gyi dmigs khrid/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ bir bsrungs phyi nang / bla ma rin 'byung / tshar gsum khug pa sogs byin rlabs gang 'gro/

bzhi pa'i dmigs pa rdzogs nas/ sgrub pa lung sbyin dang gsang bcu'i rgyas btab/ de rjes tshogs 'khor rgyas pa dang / de'i sang gur zhal gyi mchod gtor rgyas pa bshams nas/ gtang rag gi tshul du skang gso gtor sgrub gang zab gnang gi 'dug lags/ gzhan yang dag pa gsum gyi 'khrid dang / lam sbas bshad kyi byin rlabs/ 'khrid 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa/ bka' babs phyi ma gsum gyi dbang / lam skor phyi ma'i lung byin rlabs ma chad pa yod pa rnams dang / sras don ma la sogs pa gzhung bshad kyi lung yod nges rnams mdzad/ phal cher grub pa'i mthar gur mgon dpa' gcig gi rjes snang mdzad/ 'di rnams kyang / khyi dang glo ba 'phrad pa lta bu hab thob tu mi byed pa/ thog mar slob dpon gyi rten 'brel legs par rtags/ de nas bla ma dkon mchog dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gsol ba 'debs shing / rim gyis 'chad pa ni/ ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa/ gsang chen blo bshad zab mo'o/ /thun mong ba tshogs pa la bshad pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun sgrub kyi gsung rab zab mo/ rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi dgongs don mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho rnams las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mas/ slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa la gdams pa ris kyi rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su med pa rnams la bka' babs pa gsung rab thor bu'i tshul dang / gsung rgyun du bzhugs pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam sprul dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ de'i rnam bshad thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa chen pos mdzad pa/ bdag 'jug chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas mdzad pa/ slob ma la dbang bskur chog rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i dbang chu chen mo dbang gong ma bskur chog glegs bam nang bzhin/

de dag gi gsal byed brag thog pa'i bdag 'jug 'khrid yig sbas don gsal ba lam dbang bskur chog gzhung bshad man ngag bshad mdzod/ 'khrul 'khor byin rlabs sogs rje btsun gong ma lnga dang bla ma dam pa theg chen chos rje ste 'jam dbyangs rnam sprul bdun gyi gsung rabs ji lta ba bzhin 'chad cing nyams su len pa/ dpal ldan sngags 'chang 'jigs med dpa' bo mthu ston thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i ring lugs ni rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs don/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba bla na med pa yin lags/ zhes lam 'bras 'chad lugs kyi tho chung 'di yang / thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bdag cag snyigs ma'i sems can mgon med rnams kyi skyabs mgon du bsam bzhin du sku sprul pa/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i bka'i gnang ba thob pa la brten/ rgyal khams pa tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan gyis brjed 'chang du bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa badz+ra sā dhu'o// //maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 18 tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan/ tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 17
